content.thinking:
My sed replacement for the channel expectation string didn't apply (the check line differs). Let me look at the actual test file content and fix it properly. The channel expectation: `fp(b'p0'+ctok.encode())` → should now be the full channel: "GET /p0 HTTP/1.1
Host: h
" + etok + "

". And the owners check line index. Let me just edit the file directly with a cleaner rewrite of those three checks.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='t2_expressions.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""check('random channel coord', r['channels'][0]['bytes'], fp(b'p0'+ctok.encode()))
check('random channel owners', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owners'], [['a',2+len(etok)])""",
"""prefix = b'GET /p0 HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: h\\r\\n'
check('random channel coord', r['channels'][0]['bytes'], fp(prefix+ctok.encode()+b'\\r\\n\\r\\n'))
check('random channel committed', r['channels'][0]['committed'], [0,1])
check('random channel owners', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owners'], [['a',len(prefix)+len(ctok)+4]])""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "random channel" t2_expressions.py; cd /workspace/project && python3 /workspace/tmp/t2_expressions.py 2>&1 | tail -45
